events.label: Season Opener
events.description: 49ers vs Seahawks to kick off 2025. High hopes after disappointing 2024.

events.label: Brock's First TD
events.description: Brock finds the endzone early. That's my quarterback!

events.label: Defense Steps Up
events.description: Robert Saleh's return paying dividends. Defense looks sharp.

events.label: First Interception
events.description: Brock throws his first pick of the season. Here we go again...

events.label: Injury Scare
events.description: Brock gets hurt scrambling late in first half. Please be okay...

events.label: Gutsy Return
events.description: Brock comes back in the second half. Tough as nails.

events.label: Second Pick
events.description: Another Brock interception. The accuracy concerns are real.

events.label: Team Rallies
events.description: Defense and running game keep us in it despite QB struggles.

events.label: Clutch Fourth Quarter
events.description: Brock delivers when it matters most. 2 TDs, 277 yards total.

events.label: Week 1 Victory
events.description: 49ers gut out win over Seahawks. Season starts 1-0!

events.label: Injury News
events.description: Brock out 2-5 weeks with turf toe. Mac Jones time.

events.label: Mac Steps Up
events.description: Mac Jones gets the start vs Saints. Team rallies around backup.

events.label: Defense Dominates
events.description: 49ers defense steps up huge without their franchise QB.

events.label: Mac's Moment
events.description: Mac Jones throws TD pass. Maybe we can survive without Brock.

events.label: Close Game Nerves
events.description: Saints making it close without our QB1. Anxiety rising.

events.label: Victory Without Brock
events.description: 26-21 win over Saints! Team proves it can win without Purdy.

events.label: Cardinals at Home
events.description: Division rival Cardinals come to Levi's. Must-win at home.

events.label: Brock's Return?
events.description: Hope builds that Brock might return ahead of schedule.

events.label: Still Mac Time
events.description: Brock still out, Mac gets another start. Prove it again.

events.label: Division Statement
events.description: Dominant win vs Cardinals shows we're still NFC West kings.

events.label: Jaguars Visit
events.description: Jacksonville comes to town. Should be a get-right game.

events.label: Brock Cleared!
events.description: Brock Purdy cleared to return! My quarterback is back!

events.label: Rusty Return
events.description: Brock looks rusty in first quarter back. Expected growing pains.

events.label: Chemistry Building
events.description: Brock and receivers finding rhythm again. Looking smooth.

events.label: Blowout Win
events.description: 49ers demolish Jaguars. Brock sharp, team clicking.

events.label: Tough Opponent
events.description: Facing a quality opponent in Week 5. Real test ahead.

events.label: Brock's Big Throw
events.description: Brock uncorks 45-yard bomb. The arm talent is real.

events.label: Defense Struggles
events.description: 49ers defense gets torched. Offense has to carry the load.

events.label: Shootout Mode
events.description: High-scoring affair. Brock trading scores in must-win game.

events.label: Game-Winner
events.description: Brock leads game-winning drive with 90 seconds left. Clutch gene!
